best_ability.name: Stake
best_ability.scaling: Max Bonus Damage 90 base · ×2.3 per Spirit Power
best_ability.why: Honest framing: Vindicta's rifle does the killing — but Stake's bonus damage scales at ×2.3, the best rate in her kit, and a staked target is a dead target. The NUKE turns her setup tool into a scaling execute enabler, with cooldown stacking so the stake is always out.

Healing cut beats max-HP shred when they out-sustain the burst.

nuke.kit_synergy: Every imbue goes on Stake. Charge and cooldown items keep a stake ready every rotation, Surge feeds the ×2.3 bonus damage, and the rifle converts every pin into a kill — the nuke is the setup, the shot is the signature.
